blocks.text: Condo buildings in Riverwood

Riverwood's attached market is mostly townhouses plus one verified apartment-condo building at the Fremont edge. Port Coquitlam's verified condo stock otherwise sits in other sub-areas and is counted there, not here: Central Pt Coquitlam holds 4 counted buildings (Montrose Square, Symphony at Gates Park, Lumiere, The POCO) plus 4 cross-referenced (The Shaughnessy, Mayfair Terrace, Shaughnessy Square, Luxora), and Glenwood PQ holds 4 (The Arden, The Sapphire, Portica West, Lexford by Polygon). Email check. The correct email is jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.
Fremont Green — 550 Seaborne Place

By Mosaic Homes. MLS listing data for units in the building records: Apartment/Condo sub-type, Freehold Strata title, built 2014, board sub-area Riverwood, with clubhouse/exercise amenities at The River Club. Unit count: Not confirmed from the sources checked. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: Not confirmed from the sources checked — read the registered bylaws on the Form B.
Streets, schools and getting around Riverwood

items.t: Municipality and identity: Riverwood is an established residential neighbourhood on the north-east side of the City of Port Coquitlam, named as an established residential neighbourhood in the City's Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 3838), around Riverwood Gate and Coast Meridian Road by the Pitt River; Terry Fox Secondary School is at 1260 Riverwood Gate. Boundary roads are not verified — no City neighbourhood map states them.
"Riverwood" is also the board (GVR) sub-area name used in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report, so the City name and the board name match.

Where the condo stock sits: at the area's south-east Fremont edge on Seaborne Place (Fremont Green); the balance of the documented form is single-detached houses under RS1–RS4 zones and townhouse strata.

Schools (SD43, address-based; locator run for 1260 Riverwood Gate): Blakeburn Elementary, Minnekhada Middle and Terry Fox Secondary; Blakeburn Elementary is at 1040 Riverside Drive nearby. Run the exact address in the SD43 locator before relying on a catchment.

Roads and transit: Coast Meridian Road and Riverwood Gate connect south to Lougheed Highway and the Pitt River Bridge corridor; TransLink buses connect to Port Coquitlam Station (West Coast Express) and Coquitlam Central Station (Millennium Line); specific route numbers through Riverwood are not verified. Hyde Creek Recreation Centre (1379 Laurier Avenue) serves the north side; the Traboulay PoCo Trail passes the Pitt River side near Riverwood.
Nearby areas: Citadel PQ west, Mary Hill south, the Dominion Avenue and Fremont growth areas east, and Pitt Meadows across the Pitt River.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Riverwood

items.t: Port Coquitlam property taxes: 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on current taxes unpaid after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; utility bills are flat annual water and sewer fees billed separately, due March 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Riverwood

items.t: The same developer sells and rents on the same street. Mosaic built both Fremont Green (550 Seaborne Place, strata, 2014) and the rental building at 553 Seaborne Place, and built Dominion's 114 rowhomes/townhouses at 2423 Avon Place in 2012 — a buyer comparing "Fremont" addresses has to establish which tenure each address is before comparing anything.

Riverwood's attached market outran its detached market in September 2026. 38% sales ratio for condos & townhomes against 20% for detached (SnapStats GVR September 2026) — the townhouse-heavy stock is what moves here.

A complex named "Riverwood" inside Riverwood is townhouses, not the neighbourhood's condo building. The 3075 Skeena Street complex (built 1995 per the directory) shares the sub-area's name; the one apartment-condo building carries a different name entirely (Fremont Green).

The secondary school is the neighbourhood's namesake anchor. Terry Fox Secondary at 1260 Riverwood Gate is named for Port Coquitlam's Terry Fox, who grew up in the city, and the locator run for its own address returns it as the catchment secondary — the school path (Blakeburn → Minnekhada → Terry Fox) is one of the few fully locator-settled paths in the PoCo sub-areas.

PoCo advertises the lowest average taxes in Metro Vancouver — and bills utilities separately. The City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver; utilities are flat annual water and sewer fees due March 31, separate from the July 2 tax due date, so a strata budget and a house budget carry the charge differently.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Riverwood
Mountain View Estates — 1055 Riverwood Gate. STRATA
Built 2003 per the directory; individual listings record 2002–2004 by unit, so the exact year per unit is not confirmed. Unit count: Not confirmed — no citable source checked publishes one.
Dominion — 2423 Avon Place and 2428 Nile Gate. FREEHOLD STRATA

Fresh verification Nov 2, 2026: a current listing for a unit at 2423 Avon Place records sub-type Row / Townhouse, strata fees and a healthy CRF in its text, and a building-directory record for Dominion at 2428 Nile Gate states strata bylaws of pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed; a current listing at a neighbouring Avon Place address records Title to Land: Freehold Strata for a Mosaic townhouse unit — tenure for the complex is carried as freehold strata on the directory's strata-bylaw record plus those listings, and is confirmed per unit on the Form B. Some Dominion units are offered for rent through a rental manager — individual rentals inside a strata, not a tenure change.
Riverwood — 3075 Skeena Street. STRATA (basis stated)

Tenure basis: the directory's strata-bylaw record for the named complex; explicit title wording is not printed in the sources checked — title-level wording not confirmed, confirm on the Form B. Unit count: Not confirmed. Note the name trap: the complex shares the sub-area's name — it is one townhouse complex, not the neighbourhood.

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: the Riverwood Gate corridor (Mountain View Estates), the Fremont-edge Avon Place / Nile Gate pocket (Dominion, beside the Fremont Green condo building), and Skeena Street (the complex named Riverwood).
Blakeburn Elementary is at 1040 Riverside Drive nearby. Catchments are address-based — that chain is settled for the sample address only; any other address needs its own locator run.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Riverwood

items.t: Secondary suites (Port Coquitlam): The City also waives 50% of the extra suite utility levy when the suite is occupied by a parent or grandparent of the owner, and 100% when a paid caregiver (minimum $150/month) lives in the suite to care for a permanently disabled owner or family member (annual application, due Dec 31).

blocks.text: Good to know about Riverwood

items.t: The neighbourhood and a complex share one name. "Riverwood" is both the Port Coquitlam sub-area and a 1995 townhouse complex at 3075 Skeena Street; the sub-area's one apartment-condo building carries a different name entirely (Fremont Green). A name-based search blends all three.

The secondary school is the neighbourhood's anchor, and its catchment chain is one of the few settled ones in PoCo. Terry Fox Secondary at 1260 Riverwood Gate is named for Port Coquitlam's Terry Fox, who grew up in the city, and the locator run for its own address returns the full Blakeburn → Minnekhada → Terry Fox path.

PoCo bills utilities separately from taxes, on a different date. Property taxes were due July 2, 2026, but flat annual water and sewer utility fees are billed separately and were due March 31, 2026 — a strata budget and a house budget carry the charge differently, and a buyer closing between the two dates can inherit the wrong assumption about what is already paid.

A Riverwood house lot can carry a caregiver-suite tax break a townhouse cannot. The City waives the extra suite utility levy entirely when a paid caregiver lives in the suite to care for a permanently disabled owner or family member, and halves it for a parent or grandparent occupant — a Riverwood-specific reason some downsizers add a suite to an RS house instead of buying the townhouse.

blocks.text: Riverwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

66 townhomes sold in Riverwood with a median price of $881,750 (the middle half sold between $816,250 and $975,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $581 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $395 a month. 5 condos sold in Riverwood with a median price of $638,000, taking a median of 40 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $750 per square foot, a median year built of 2016 and a median strata fee of $455 a month.
